title: 工業科教育法
subtitle: Educational Methods for Engineering
courseType:
Teacher Certification Program
Teacher Certification Courses
keywords: Industrial Education 2.Engineer Ethics 3.Course of Study 4.Lesson Plan 5.Lesson Demonstration
educationalGoal: The objectives of industrial education are to acquire basic and practical skill, to understand the significance of industry in the current society, to solve problems of industrial technologies taking environment into account. In this course, students who aim to be an industry teacher design and practice an industrial lesson to achieve the above objectives.
advice: This course can be divided into the following two parts. Part 1: (1) The history and the current state of industrial education (2) The course of study and the overview of the subject “Industry” (3) Instructional design for the subject “Industry” (4) To make a scenario of a lesson in group activities Part 2: (5) To make a scenario of a lesson in personal activities (6) To make lesson practice, and discuss about it (7) To reflect on the lesson demonstration and improve the lesson
books: Nakamura, T. et al. (2019) Atarashi Kanten to Jissen ni Motoduku Kougyouka-Kyouiku-hou no Kenkyu (Revised edition). Jikkyou-Shuppan.(A Study on Educational Methids for "Industry" Based on a New Perspective and Practice.) The Course of Study "Industry". by Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, JAPAN
requiredKnowledge: To have basic knowledge of industry.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the method and the content of the subject “Industry.
Be able to understand problems industrial of education in high school, and improvements for them.
Be able to design industrial lessons.
Be able to practice a lesson of the subject "Industry".
Engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Identify the problem of industrial education with the basic knowledge of industrial education, and specify the direction of improvement. (2) Understand the basic knowledge and skill of teaching method, and design an active-learning lesson. (3) Understand each area of the subject "Industry" deeply, make effective teaching materials.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Identify the problem of industrial education with the basic knowledge of industrial education. (2) Understand the basic knowledge and skill of teaching method, and design a lesson. (3) Understand each area of the subject "Industry", and make teaching materials.
